contract.child_policy_text: Child Supplements - FB USD 30, HB USD 19, BB USD 7 Net per child. Kids Policy: 00 - 05.99 years old will be on FOC when they accompany with parents; Between 06 - 11.99 years old will be on 50% off rate and Christmas/ New Year's eve Gala dinner; Above 12 years on adult rates. Extra Bed (Maximum 1 Sofa bed / room): USD 23 Net per night inclusive breakfast (Adult / Child); Full extra-bed and meal charges for children between the age of 12-17 years; Full extra-bed and 50% of meal charges for children 6-11 years. (Small print: "There will be no charge for children under the age of 18 traveling with parents and staying in the same room" — contradicts the above.)
contract.cancellation_text: CANCELLATION POLICY: FIT Booking – 09 Rooms & Below:- APPLICABLE DURING: Rest of the year. Full Year with the exception of (Y) Easter & Summer and (Z) Festive dates: 50% of FB room rate for the length of stay for cancellation received within 8 -14 days; 100% of FB room rate for the length of stay for cancellation received less than 07 days. APPLICABLE DURING: EASTER AND SUMMER: (Y) 25-Mar-27 to 15-Apr-27, 14-Jun-27 to 24-Aug-27: 50% of FB room rate for the length of stay for cancellation received within 22- 30 days; 100% of FB room rate for the length of stay for cancellation received less than 21 days. APPLICABLE DURING FESTIVE SEASON (Z) 20-Dec-27 to 07-Jan-28: 100% of BB room rate for the length of stay for cancellation received less than 30 days. EARLY DEPARTURE FEE: the full nights stay, subject to change (guests should advise at or before check-in of any change in length of stay).
contract.payment_text: PAYMENT POLICY: Unless you have received notification in writing from the Hotel that your credit has been approved, all reservations must be paid in full prior to the guest's arrival; otherwise the guest must make a new reservation at the prevailing rate on arrival. If credit is approved in writing by the Hotel or Hilton: thirty (30) day credit privileges for room and tax; invoices due on receipt and payment received no later than thirty (30) days after receipt of invoice. All outstanding amounts sixty (60) days and over: interest of Prime + 2%. The Hotel may review credit periodically and require pre-payment at any time. Billing contact: Hasitha Deshan, +94 47 2030 100, fax +94 47 2030 110, Hasitha.deshan@Hilton.com.
contract.terms_text: F.I.T. RATE AGREEMENT (Doubletree by Hilton Weerawila). Hotel: KDU Adventures (Pvt) Ltd d.b.a. Doubletree by Hilton Weerawila Rajawarna Resort; hotel contact Suresh De Silva, 2 Sir Chittampalam A Gardiner Mawatha, Colombo 00200; hotel phone +94 112 492 492; sales phone +9476 9174607. COMPANY NAME / address / account number on the agreement: BLANK. Effective dates of agreement: 16th January 2027 to 15th January 2028. Rates: FULL BOARD / HALF BOARD / BED AND BREAKFAST, Double Pax, Tax & SC inclusive; FB * Single Pax: -$-41; 3+ Pax: +54/pax; HB * Single Pax: -$-28; 3+ Pax: +41/pax; BB * Single Pax: -$-11; 3+ Pax: +24/pax. SUPPLEMENTS: Breakfast – USD 14 net per person; Lunch – USD 22 net per person; Dinner – USD 24 net per person; Christmas Gala dinner on 24th Dec: $110 net per person; New Year's Eve Gala dinner and midnight toast on 31st Dec: $140 per person. UPGRADE SURCHARGES: Deluxe Garden view room with terrace to Deluxe Room with Balcony US$ 14 net per room per night; Deluxe Garden view room with terrace to Deluxe Suite with Balcony US$ 108 net per room per night. EXTRA BED (Maximum 1 Sofa bed / room): USD 23 Net per night inclusive breakfast (Adult / Child). Executive Lounge Benefits: N/A. Extra Benefits: Free Wifi access, Gym and all hotel facilities. Blackout dates: No. Tax inclusive: Yes, tax percentage 24.35%, other tax 10% Service Charge included. Breakfast inclusive: both Yes and No ticked. Static rates (not directly connected) may not be used online. Small print: "The above rates are net non-commissionable and are quoted exclusive of applicable commonwealth and local taxes, currently 34% and subject to change without notice ... Local fire safety restrictions govern total room occupancy." RESERVATIONS: weerawila_reservations@hilton.com, tel 0472 030101/03. Rooms over allotment may be available at FIT rate category or at prevailing rates. The agreement includes the "F.I.T. Rate Agreement (Hilton Colombo) – Additional Terms and Conditions" (not in the folder) and "will not be valid and enforceable until a signed copy is returned to the Hotel by 24th September 2026". Hotel signatory: Samindri Liyanage, Cluster Commercial Director Sales (unsigned / undated in this copy). TERMS AND CONDITIONS: CHECK-IN 15h00 / CHECK-OUT 12h00; early check-in / late check-out on availability and subject to additional charge; for guaranteed early check-in the previous night is charged at the full contracted rate; late departure charge (until 16:00 hours) 50% of the rate of the day. Baggage handling fees are the responsibility of the guest. RATES VALID FOR PACKAGED TRAVEL ONLY (FIT package tours / FIT tour programs); not to be offered as room-only inventory; hotel price not to be itemized or visible to the end customer; total package substantially greater than the room component; not packaged with inappropriate items; package rates not to be released to other parties or internet distribution; non-transferable. PERFORMANCE: rates based on a minimum of 100 room-nights between 2027/28; the Hotel may adjust rates at the end of each quarter if production is below expectations. TERMINATION: 30 days' written notice without cause; immediately on insolvency or uncured material breach (15 days). Hotel and Hilton may refuse entry to / remove guests behaving unacceptably. Operator must advise guests of Hilton terms, check-in / check-out times and material information (facility closures, refurbishment).
contract.notes: Transcribed from "DTW 2027 contract.pdf" (4 pages), saved to the winter RTS folder on 2 Oct 2026. DoubleTree by Hilton Weerawila (6-9-11-11354) is not in the local copy (UNKNOWN CODE locally — expected; validate on live). Seven printed season rows × three tables (FB, HB, BB "Double Pax, Tax & SC inclusive") × three rooms; the From / To date columns are used where the labels carry typos (FB "10-Apr-2", FB "20-Dec-27 to 15-Jan-27", BB "2High Season"). SGL = DBL − the printed single-pax reduction (FB 41 / HB 28 / BB 11); TPL = DBL + the printed 3+ pax supplement (FB 54 / HB 41 / BB 24); no quad (maximum 1 sofa bed per room). Kinds: Peak 10–20 Apr and High 16 Jul – 31 Aug → peak; Peak 20 Dec 2027 – 15 Jan 2028 → festive; Low → low. Room names are the table headers spelled out: "K1DS/T2DS/K1RRD/T2RRD, DLX Garden View" → Deluxe Garden View; "K1DV/T2DV, DLX w/ Balcony" → Deluxe with Balcony; "K1RVU1, King 1BDRM Suite" → King 1 Bedroom Suite (the hotel has no room types on live yet). Every room is priced in every table, so the printed upgrade surcharges (+14 Balcony, +108 Suite per room per night) are NOT entered as room supplements; they do not match the tables (Balcony − Garden View = 14 FB/HB but 13 BB; Suite − Garden View = 81 FB/HB, 80 BB). Galas 24 Dec 2027 USD 110 net pp and 31 Dec 2027 USD 140 pp (children 6–11.99 50%). Extra meals breakfast 14 / lunch 22 / dinner 24 net pp entered as meal prices (no RO rate derived). Child: 0–5.99 free; 6–11.99 child supplement BB 7 / HB 19 / FB 30 (= 50% of the printed meal prices) entered as child-without-extra-bed rows; the with-extra-bed child price (extra bed USD 23 incl. breakfast + 50% of meals) is left to the text. Cancellation: FIT 09 rooms & below only (nothing printed for larger groups); "rest of the year" = the agreement period minus (Y) and (Z). Contradictions to confirm with the hotel: tax inclusive (tables, tick box 24.35% + 10% SC) vs "exclusive of ... taxes, currently 34%" (small print) — entered as inclusive; children free under 18 (small print) vs the kids policy; extra bed USD 23 incl. breakfast vs 3+ pax BB +24; "Breakfast inclusive" ticked both Yes and No. The COMPANY NAME field is blank (agreement not addressed to Avenir by name) and the agreement was "not valid until a signed copy is returned to the Hotel by 24th September 2026" — confirm Avenir signed it. No contract date printed (PDF created 24 Sep 2026). Guide / driver accommodation not printed.
